reason: Nobody I know is using it. It's brand new with zero customers, and I don't touch software until another operator at the association tells me it actually works. I also don't have time to learn a new system and move all my bookings over on a stranger's word.
objection: Brand new company, nobody using it. If it falls over or they go broke, my bookings and driver records go down with them. And I'd be the one stuck teaching myself and my drivers a new system at night.
would_change_my_mind: An operator I know and trust, running a fleet my size, telling me they've used it for a few months, it saves them time, and setting it up wasn't a headache.
